answer: An agent economy can curb clones by issuing expiring single-use work tokens tied to each agent identity key. A token is earned only after verified work in the prior epoch, like a gale that clears stale claims, and it unlocks exactly one next action before it expires. Like a vault, the token cannot be copied or handed to a mirror identity: any reuse or transfer attempt is detected and the token is forfeited. Attackers must therefore redo real work for every identity, making mass sybils costly and short-lived.
